path.description: Path of the artifact in the project.
path.title: Path

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact, without the calkit.
sha256.title: Sha256

size.description: Size in bytes, without the calkit.
size.title: Size

stage.description: Name of the pipeline stage that makes it.
stage.title: Stage

included.description: Whether the file is in the calkit, under 'project/'. Files left out can be fetched from the project's DVC remote, or remade by running the pipeline.
included.title: Included

md5.description: DVC's MD5 of the file, for fetching it from DVC storage.
md5.title: Md5

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, if it's in the calkit.
sha256.title: Sha256

storage.description: Where the project keeps the file.
storage.title: Storage

message.description: How it leads to the artifact.
message.title: Message

path.description: Path nothing records the origin of.
path.title: Path

unchecked.description: Whether it's recorded as imported, but from somewhere nobody else can check, e.g., a folder on someone's machine.
unchecked.title: Unchecked

commit_sha.description: Git commit the calkit was made from.
commit_sha.title: Commit Sha

git_remotes.description: Git remote URLs by name, without credentials.
git_remotes.title: Git Remotes

hub_url.description: URL of the project's page on a Calkit hub, if it names one, where '/files?path=PATH&ref=COMMIT_SHA' shows a file at a commit.
hub_url.title: Hub Url

uncommitted_paths.description: Files in the calkit with changes not in that commit.
uncommitted_paths.title: Uncommitted Paths

up_to_date.description: Whether the artifact's stage, and every stage upstream of it, was up to date when the calkit was made.
up_to_date.title: Up To Date

description: The calkit-kit.json at the root of a calkit, the ZIP embedded in an artifact holding what made it. See https://docs.calkit.org/calkits

$schema.description: URL of this schema, which says where to learn more.
$schema.title: $Schema

created_with.description: Tool and version that made it.
created_with.title: Created With

files.description: Files the artifact's pipeline uses, in the calkit or not.
files.title: Files

provenance_gaps.description: Inputs upstream of the artifact that no stage makes and that have no recorded origin, e.g., an import or who created them.
provenance_gaps.title: Provenance Gaps

title: Calkit manifest
